mcp_server_installation_state.user_experience: Users must manually edit the Claude Desktop configuration file (claude_desktop_config.json) located at ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/ on macOS or %APPDATA%\Claude\ on Windows. The file contains a JSON object with an 'mcpServers' key, where each server is defined by its name, command, and args. Example: {"mcpServers": {"my-server": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem"]}}}. No GUI or marketplace exists. Users must know the exact server package name and CLI invocation. This is documented in Anthropic's official MCP documentation and release notes as of v0.4.0.
mcp_server_installation_state.release_notes_reference: Claude Desktop v0.4.0 (March 2026) - MCP support added; v0.5.0 (May 2026) - no GUI changes
mcp_server_installation_state.agent_to_agent_opportunity: None directly; this is a manual user task. However, agents could automate config file generation and deployment via file system MCP server.
